datasets.name: ArASL2018 / Arabic Alphabets Sign Language Dataset
datasets.version_or_subset: Hugging Face snapshot pain/ArASL_Database_Grayscale (single 'train' split; parquet), revision 114709884276379a01e0722d71cd590c8ad3a05d
datasets.license_or_permission: CC BY 4.0 (Hugging Face dataset card); underlying corpus is Latif, Mohammad, Alghazo, AlKhalaf & AlKhalaf, "ArASL: Arabic Alphabets Sign Language Dataset," Data in Brief 23:103777, 2019, released 'publicly available and free for all researchers.' Permits this project-cloud training run.
datasets.notes: The single 54,049-image/32-class 'train' split is repartitioned into the paper's own 64/16/20 stratified train/validation/test split at run time (Algorithm 1); there is no author-published test split to match. Identity check: exact 54,049 total and exact 32-class label set independently match both the paper's stated dataset size and the Data in Brief description; native per-image resolution is 64x64 grayscale for 53,401/54,049 rows, with 648 rows (1.2%) natively 256x256 or 768x1024 (10 of those RGB) -- consistent with the original corpus's reported per-image dimension variation, and handled by the paper's own resize-to-64x64 preprocessing step rather than being a data-integrity problem. The paper cites two Mendeley listings for what states the same 54,049-image/32-class corpus (refs [18] DOI 10.17632/6y5dwtrdth.1 and [19] Data in Brief 10.1016/j.dib.2019.103777); this Hugging Face mirror's homepage points to the [19] listing (data.mendeley.com/datasets/y7pckrw6z2/1). The Mendeley original was not independently re-downloaded because the mirror's exact sample/class counts and per-image characteristics already establish dataset identity.

metric_definitions.name: Test accuracy
metric_definitions.implementation: argmax(softmax output) equality against the integer label, over the held-out test split

metric_definitions.name: Macro-averaged precision
metric_definitions.aggregation: unweighted mean of per-class precision over all 32 classes

metric_definitions.name: Macro-averaged recall
metric_definitions.aggregation: unweighted mean of per-class recall over all 32 classes

metric_definitions.name: Macro-averaged F1
metric_definitions.aggregation: unweighted mean of per-class F1 over all 32 classes

experiments.system: Baseline CNN: 3 Conv(32/64/128, 3x3, ReLU) blocks each with MaxPooling+BatchNorm, Flatten, Dense(512, ReLU), Dropout(0.5), Dense(32, softmax); optimizer not stated in paper, Adam used (documented default)
experiments.checkpoint_rule: Report the fixed final epoch (30 per Table II); no best-checkpoint selection
experiments.paper_evidence: Paper §III.B.1, Fig. 2, Table II CNN row

experiments.system: Baseline CNN architecture with Harris Hawks Optimization tuning learning rate, batch size, conv filter count, and dropout rate to maximize validation accuracy, then a fixed final retrain
experiments.checkpoint_rule: Report the fixed final epoch (5 per Table II) of the HHO-selected configuration; no best-checkpoint selection
experiments.paper_evidence: Paper §III.B.6, Fig. 7, Table II CNN-HHO row

experiments.system: ImageNet-pretrained EfficientNet-B0 (frozen backbone), input resized to 224x224x3, GlobalMaxPooling, Dense(256, ReLU), Dropout(0.6), Dense(32, softmax); Adamax, lr=0.001
experiments.checkpoint_rule: Report the fixed final epoch (70 per Table II); no best-checkpoint selection
experiments.paper_evidence: Paper §III.B.2, Figs. 3-4, Table II EfficientNet-B0 row

experiments.system: ImageNet-pretrained EfficientNet-B3 (frozen backbone), same head/optimizer recipe as EfficientNet-B0 (paper describes B0 and B3 together)
experiments.checkpoint_rule: Report the fixed final epoch (84 per Table II); no best-checkpoint selection

experiments.system: ImageNet-pretrained ResNet50 (frozen backbone), Flatten, Dropout, Dense(32, softmax); Adamax
experiments.checkpoint_rule: Report the fixed final epoch (60 per Table II); no best-checkpoint selection
experiments.paper_evidence: Paper §III.B.3, Fig. 5, Table II ResNet50 row

experiments.system: ImageNet-pretrained DenseNet201 (frozen backbone), Flatten, Dropout(0.8), Dense(32, softmax); Adamax
experiments.checkpoint_rule: Report the fixed final epoch (150 per Table II); no best-checkpoint selection

experiments.system: ImageNet-pretrained DenseNet121 (frozen backbone), MaxPooling+BatchNorm, Flatten, Dense(512, ReLU), Dropout, Dense(32, softmax [paper states sigmoid; overridden, see deviations]); Adam
experiments.checkpoint_rule: Report the fixed final epoch (12 per Table II); no best-checkpoint selection
experiments.paper_evidence: Paper §III.B.5, Fig. 6, Table II DenseNet121 row

experiments.system: DenseNet121 architecture (as above) with Harris Hawks Optimization tuning learning rate, batch size, and dropout rate to maximize validation accuracy, then a fixed final retrain
experiments.checkpoint_rule: Report the fixed final epoch (5 per Table II) of the HHO-selected configuration; no best-checkpoint selection
